rules.universe: Latest original scheduled Top20, refreshed only on original horizon calendar; same requested full endpoint.
rules.entries: Flat intended issuers may enter on the preceding close technical signal between scheduled refreshes; fixed original 1/20 weight, unused allocation remains cash.
rules.execution: Close signal executes at next exchange open. Blocked buys persist until filled, explicit exit, or universe removal; unknown inputs create no new intent.
rules.exits: Explicit close exit or removal from intended Top20 creates persistent exit until flat; never cancel a blocked exit with an on-state before liquidation.
rules.holding: No daily resizing of positive holdings outside original scheduled refresh. At refresh, non-exiting held intended names resize to original equal target.
rules.reentry: After an exit fills, a new later close entry may reopen at following open; never exit and reenter same open.
rules.unknown: Unknown exit alone preserves existing positions; unresolved positive holding valuation stops account without full metrics.
rules.industry: No separate standalone industry timing formula specified originally; remains unresolved rather than inventing an outcome-fitted gate.
rules.family: All original 24 comparisons retain family threshold; partial technical runs cannot establish full-family selection.
rules.new_buys: Buy execution additionally requires a known non-ST current-session status from the bound original historical provider file. Missing status or ST blocks a buy, never deletes an existing holding. Beijing/CDR absent from original intended Top20 keys.

limitations: Clarification is after original protocol and ranking research; cannot claim originally prespecified execution semantics.
No 2026 data used for fitting, timing account selection or this historical replay.
